events.info: Experience the magic and enchantment of The Nutcracker as Ballet Virginia brings this beloved holiday classic to life on stage! Featuring a cast of over 100 dancers and the talents of Ballet Virginia?s professional company. This dazzling production will be accompanied by the live, sweeping sounds of Tchaikovsky?s iconic score performed by Symphonicity Orchestra. From waltzing flowers to playful mice and the delightful Sugar Plum Fairy, it?s a heartwarming celebration that promises lasting memories and joyful holiday spirit.
